acs.text_first_line: The chart deploys the api and the worker, the migration job and the pinned classifier artefact
The classifier artefact is versioned, promoted and rollback-able and the evaluation gate blocks a bad model
The configuration, the parameter reads and the feature flag are in force
The worker joins the 15-minute intake Schedule and scales without a second Schedule
The dashboards and the alerts cover the confidence distribution and the review reasons
The runbook and the rollback cover the legacy signals
